==> README.md <==
# Docker Compose deployment

Run `docker compose up --build` from this directory. The hub starts first; every segment registers its compiled contract and waits for all handlers to be ready.

Configure images, runtime settings, and published ports in the web composer Deploy tab. Review the generated files, then download a new bundle after changes. Runtime images must provide the libraries needed by their executables.

Each segment takes its roster from the hub when it starts: the loaded instances of every segment, at least `min_replicas` of each (one by default). An instance that starts later joins: once it is ready, the segments already running route to it, so `docker compose up --scale <segment>=N` adds instances. Scaling works only for a segment that publishes no host port: two containers cannot bind one port. An instance that is stopped retires: the others stop routing to it, and it leaves once it has drained. Kubernetes and srt-slurm are not generated.

==> compose.yaml <==
{
  "services": {
    "engine": {
      "build": {
        "context": ".",
        "dockerfile": "engine/Dockerfile"
      },
      "depends_on": {
        "hub": {
          "condition": "service_healthy"
        }
      },
      "healthcheck": {
        "interval": "5s",
        "retries": 3,
        "start_period": "1800s",
        "test": [
          "CMD",
          "/usr/local/bin/segment",
          "--healthcheck",
          "/etc/gdl/config"
        ],
        "timeout": "3s"
      },
      "init": true,
      "ports": [],
      "stop_grace_period": "630s"
    },
    "front": {
      "build": {
        "context": ".",
        "dockerfile": "front/Dockerfile"
      },
      "depends_on": {
        "hub": {
          "condition": "service_healthy"
        }
      },
      "healthcheck": {
        "interval": "5s",
        "retries": 3,
        "start_period": "1800s",
        "test": [
          "CMD",
          "/usr/local/bin/segment",
          "--healthcheck",
          "/etc/gdl/config"
        ],
        "timeout": "3s"
      },
      "init": true,
      "ports": [],
      "stop_grace_period": "630s"
    },
    "hub": {
      "build": {
        "context": ".",
        "dockerfile": "hub/Dockerfile"
      },
      "healthcheck": {
        "interval": "2s",
        "retries": 30,
        "test": [
          "CMD",
          "/usr/local/bin/segment",
          "--healthcheck"
        ],
        "timeout": "2s"
      }
    }
  }
}

//! by the full path of the type it resolved to.

gdl_runtime::graph! {
    name = "api", schema = 1;
    source   Http: ::api_frontend::Prompt -> stream ::api_frontend::Chunk;
    sink     Engine: ::api_frontend::Prompt -> stream ::api_frontend::Chunk;
    topology: Http => Engine;

{
  "graph": {
    "name": "api",
    "schema": 1,
    "nodes": [
      {
        "name": "Http",
        "role": "source",
        "binding": null
      },
      {
        "name": "Engine",
        "role": "sink",
        "binding": "engine"
      }
    ],
    "hops": [
      {
        "outer": "Http",
        "forward": [],
        "inner": "Engine",
        "backward": [],
        "forward_types": [
          {
            "name": ":: api_frontend :: Prompt",
            "wire": true,
            "encoding": "msgpack"
          }
        ],
        "backward_types": [
          {
            "name": ":: api_frontend :: Chunk",
            "wire": true,
            "encoding": "msgpack"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "placement": {
    "segment": {
      "engine": {
        "nodes": [
          "Engine"
        ]
      },
      "front": {
        "nodes": [
          "Http"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}

WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
ENV CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build
RUN cargo build --release --manifest-path '/app/engine/Cargo.toml'
FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /build/release/api-engine /usr/local/bin/segment
COPY ["./engine/config.toml", "/etc/gdl/config"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/segment","/etc/gdl/config"]

==> engine/src/lib.rs <==
// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Segment `engine` of graph `api`, hosting `Engine`.
//!
//! [`start`] deploys it inside a program; the `api-engine` binary deploys it on
//! its own, through [`Binary`].

pub use ::api_contract as contract;

/// This segment's name in the placement.
pub const SEGMENT: &str = "engine";

/// Every segment of the placement. An instance waits for all of them,
/// or, in a cell, only for those of its class.
pub const SEGMENTS: &[&str] = &["engine", "front"];

/// The placement this crate was generated for.
pub const PLACEMENT: &str = r#"[segment.engine]
nodes = ["Engine"]

[segment.front]
nodes = ["Http"]
"#;

// Each message this segment sends or receives across a cut, or that
// returns through an anchor in it, is a wire type: an edge that carries
// one that is not fails to build here, naming the message and the edge.
// Compile time only.
#[allow(non_camel_case_types)]
type Http_to_Engine = <contract::nodes::Engine as gdl_runtime::SinkDecl>::Req;
const _: () = gdl_runtime::gdl::__private::crosses::<Http_to_Engine>();
#[allow(non_camel_case_types)]
type Engine_to_Http = <contract::nodes::Http as gdl_runtime::SourceDecl>::Item;
const _: () = gdl_runtime::gdl::__private::crosses::<Engine_to_Http>();

/// The implementations of the nodes this segment hosts.
pub struct Nodes {
    /// Node `Engine`.
    pub engine: ::api_frontend::Echo,
}

/// Deploy this segment on `node`. Every segment's instances must be in
/// `roster`.
pub fn start(
    node: gdl_runtime::velo::Velo,
    roster: &gdl_runtime::Roster,
    config: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig,
    nodes: Nodes,
) -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<
    gdl_runtime::Segment<
        impl gdl_runtime::gdl::Next<
            <contract::nodes::Http as gdl_runtime::SourceDecl>::Req,
            <contract::nodes::Http as gdl_runtime::SourceDecl>::Item,
        > + gdl_runtime::Register
        + use<>,
    >,
> {
    let placement = gdl_runtime::Placement::from_toml(PLACEMENT)?;
    let manifest = contract::manifest();
    let deployment =
        gdl_runtime::Deployment::new(node, &manifest, &placement, SEGMENT, roster, config)?;
    let root = contract::assemble(&deployment, contract::Bindings::new().engine(nodes.engine))?;
    deployment.start(root)
}

/// What this segment's binary hosts, as its settings name it.
#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Settings {
    #[serde(default)]
    node: NodeSettings,
}

impl gdl_runtime::Hosted for Settings {
    const KEYS: &'static [&'static str] = &["node"];
    const NAMES: &'static [&'static str] = &["Engine"];
}

#[derive(Default, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct NodeSettings {
    #[serde(rename = "Engine", default)]
    engine: Option<toml::Table>,
}

/// What the `api-engine` binary hosts and serves; its `main` is
/// `gdl_runtime::segment_main::<Binary>()`.
pub struct Binary;

impl gdl_runtime::SegmentBinary for Binary {
    const PACKAGE: &'static str = "api-engine";
    const SEGMENT: &'static str = SEGMENT;
    const SEGMENTS: &'static [&'static str] = SEGMENTS;
    const GRAPH_CONFIG: &'static str = "[Engine]\n\n[Http]\nenabled_anthropic = true\nenabled_chat = true\nenabled_responses = true\n\n[Http_anthropic_op]\n\n[Http_chat_b0]\n\n[Http_chat_f0]\n\n[Http_responses_op]\n";
    type Settings = Settings;
    type Hosts = Nodes;

    async fn build(
        settings: Settings,
        builder: &gdl_runtime::Builder,
    ) -> Result<Nodes, gdl_runtime::Failure> {
        let Settings { node } = settings;
        let nodes = Nodes {
            engine: builder
                .build::<::api_frontend::Echo>("Engine", node.engine)
                .await?,
        };
        Ok(nodes)
    }

    async fn ready(hosts: &Nodes) -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<()> {
        tokio::try_join!(gdl_runtime::gdl::Build::ready(&hosts.engine))?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn deployment() -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<gdl_runtime::DeploymentSpec> {
        Ok(gdl_runtime::DeploymentSpec::new(
            contract::manifest(),
            gdl_runtime::Placement::from_toml(PLACEMENT)?,
        )?)
    }

    fn start(
        hosts: Nodes,
        node: gdl_runtime::velo::Velo,
        roster: &gdl_runtime::Roster,
        runtime: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig,
    ) -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<gdl_runtime::Serving> {
        let segment = crate::start(node, roster, runtime, hosts)?;
        Ok(gdl_runtime::Serving::new(
            segment,
            |_segment, shutdown| async move {
                shutdown.cancelled().await;
                Ok(())
            },
        ))
    }
}

==> engine/src/main.rs <==
// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Runs segment `engine` on its own.
//!
//! Usage: `api-engine <config.toml> [override.toml ...]`. Files merge in argument
//! order, then `GDL_` environment variables, with `__` between nested keys
//! (`GDL_RUNTIME__ADMISSION_LIMIT=64`). `api-engine --healthcheck <config.toml> ...`
//! asks a running instance's health probe instead, as a container health check
//! does. Log events go to stderr, at the level `RUST_LOG` sets (`warn` by default).
//! The settings are:
//!
//! ```toml
//! listen = "127.0.0.1:0"  # this instance's address; under a hub, an unspecified one advertises what HOSTNAME resolves to
//! roster = "/run/roster"  # a directory every instance shares, fresh for each deployment
//! # [hub]                 # or the discovery hub: exactly one of the two
//! # host = "hub"          # its host; public_port, control_port, and heartbeat_ms (5000) are optional
//! rendezvous_ms = 30000   # optional: how long to wait for the other instances
//! [instances]             # optional, with a roster: instances per segment, 1 by default
//! [min_replicas]          # optional, with a hub: loaded instances per segment to wait for, 1 by default
//! [runtime]               # optional: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig
//! [system]                # optional: the live and health probes, off unless port is set (DYN_SYSTEM_PORT)
//! [node.Engine]           # optional: Engine's Build::Config
//! ```
//! Graph-affecting values must match the built graph.

fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    let filter = tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::builder()
        .with_default_directive(tracing_subscriber::filter::LevelFilter::WARN.into())
        .from_env_lossy();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(filter)
        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)
        .with_ansi(false)
        .init();
    gdl_runtime::segment_main::<api_engine::Binary>()
}

// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Segment `front` of graph `api`, hosting `Http`.
//!
//! [`start`] deploys it inside a program; the `api-front` binary deploys it on
//! its own, through [`Binary`].

pub use ::api_contract as contract;

/// This segment's name in the placement.
pub const SEGMENT: &str = "front";

/// Every segment of the placement. An instance waits for all of them,
/// or, in a cell, only for those of its class.
pub const SEGMENTS: &[&str] = &["engine", "front"];

/// The placement this crate was generated for.
pub const PLACEMENT: &str = r#"[segment.engine]
nodes = ["Engine"]

[segment.front]
nodes = ["Http"]
"#;

// Each message this segment sends or receives across a cut, or that
// returns through an anchor in it, is a wire type: an edge that carries
// one that is not fails to build here, naming the message and the edge.
// Compile time only.
#[allow(non_camel_case_types)]
type Http_to_Engine = <contract::nodes::Engine as gdl_runtime::SinkDecl>::Req;
const _: () = gdl_runtime::gdl::__private::crosses::<Http_to_Engine>();
#[allow(non_camel_case_types)]
type Engine_to_Http = <contract::nodes::Http as gdl_runtime::SourceDecl>::Item;
const _: () = gdl_runtime::gdl::__private::crosses::<Engine_to_Http>();

/// The implementations of the nodes this segment hosts.
pub struct Nodes {}

/// Deploy this segment on `node`. Every segment's instances must be in
/// `roster`.
pub fn start(
    node: gdl_runtime::velo::Velo,
    roster: &gdl_runtime::Roster,
    config: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig,
    nodes: Nodes,
) -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<
    gdl_runtime::Segment<
        impl gdl_runtime::gdl::Next<
            <contract::nodes::Http as gdl_runtime::SourceDecl>::Req,
            <contract::nodes::Http as gdl_runtime::SourceDecl>::Item,
        > + gdl_runtime::Register
        + use<>,
    >,
> {
    let placement = gdl_runtime::Placement::from_toml(PLACEMENT)?;
    let manifest = contract::manifest();
    let deployment =
        gdl_runtime::Deployment::new(node, &manifest, &placement, SEGMENT, roster, config)?;
    let Nodes {} = nodes;
    let root = contract::assemble(&deployment, contract::Bindings::new())?;
    deployment.start(root)
}

/// What this segment's binary hosts, as its settings name it.
#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Settings {
    #[serde(default)]
    node: NodeSettings,
    #[serde(default)]
    frontend: Option<toml::Table>,
    #[serde(default)]
    adapter: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, toml::Table>,
}

impl gdl_runtime::Hosted for Settings {
    const KEYS: &'static [&'static str] = &["node", "frontend", "adapter"];
    const NAMES: &'static [&'static str] = &[
        "Http_chat_f0",
        "Http_chat_b0",
        "Http_responses_op",
        "Http_anthropic_op",
    ];
}

#[derive(Default, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct NodeSettings {}

/// What this segment's binary builds: its nodes, and what serves the source.
pub struct Hosts {
    nodes: Nodes,
    frontend: ::api_frontend::ApiFrontend,
    entry_487474705f636861745f6630: ::api_frontend::ExtractChat,
    entry_487474705f636861745f6230: ::api_frontend::FormatChat,
    entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70: ::api_frontend::ResponsesAdapter,
    entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70: ::api_frontend::AnthropicAdapter,
}

/// What the `api-front` binary hosts and serves; its `main` is
/// `gdl_runtime::segment_main::<Binary>()`.
pub struct Binary;

impl gdl_runtime::SegmentBinary for Binary {
    const PACKAGE: &'static str = "api-front";
    const SEGMENT: &'static str = SEGMENT;
    const SEGMENTS: &'static [&'static str] = SEGMENTS;
    const GRAPH_CONFIG: &'static str = "[Engine]\n\n[Http]\nenabled_anthropic = true\nenabled_chat = true\nenabled_responses = true\n\n[Http_anthropic_op]\n\n[Http_chat_b0]\n\n[Http_chat_f0]\n\n[Http_responses_op]\n";
    type Settings = Settings;
    type Hosts = Hosts;

    async fn build(
        settings: Settings,
        builder: &gdl_runtime::Builder,
    ) -> Result<Hosts, gdl_runtime::Failure> {
        let Settings {
            node,
            frontend,
            mut adapter,
        } = settings;
        let NodeSettings {} = node;
        let nodes = Nodes {};
        let frontend = builder
            .build::<::api_frontend::ApiFrontend>("Http", frontend)
            .await?;
        let enabled: &[&str] = &[
            "Http_chat_f0",
            "Http_chat_b0",
            "Http_responses_op",
            "Http_anthropic_op",
        ];
        if let Some(unknown) = adapter.keys().find(|key| !enabled.contains(&key.as_str())) {
            return Err(format!("[adapter.{unknown}]: no enabled entry node of that name").into());
        }
        let entry_487474705f636861745f6630 = builder
            .build::<::api_frontend::ExtractChat>("Http_chat_f0", adapter.remove("Http_chat_f0"))
            .await?;
        let entry_487474705f636861745f6230 = builder
            .build::<::api_frontend::FormatChat>("Http_chat_b0", adapter.remove("Http_chat_b0"))
            .await?;
        let entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70 = builder
            .build::<::api_frontend::ResponsesAdapter>(
                "Http_responses_op",
                adapter.remove("Http_responses_op"),
            )
            .await?;
        let entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70 = builder
            .build::<::api_frontend::AnthropicAdapter>(
                "Http_anthropic_op",
                adapter.remove("Http_anthropic_op"),
            )
            .await?;
        Ok(Hosts {
            nodes,
            frontend,
            entry_487474705f636861745f6630,
            entry_487474705f636861745f6230,
            entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70,
            entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70,
        })
    }

    async fn ready(hosts: &Hosts) -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<()> {
        tokio::try_join!(
            gdl_runtime::gdl::Build::ready(&hosts.frontend),
            gdl_runtime::gdl::Build::ready(&hosts.entry_487474705f636861745f6630),
            gdl_runtime::gdl::Build::ready(&hosts.entry_487474705f636861745f6230),
            gdl_runtime::gdl::Build::ready(&hosts.entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70),
            gdl_runtime::gdl::Build::ready(&hosts.entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70)
        )?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn deployment() -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<gdl_runtime::DeploymentSpec> {
        Ok(gdl_runtime::DeploymentSpec::new(
            contract::manifest(),
            gdl_runtime::Placement::from_toml(PLACEMENT)?,
        )?)
    }

    fn start(
        hosts: Hosts,
        node: gdl_runtime::velo::Velo,
        roster: &gdl_runtime::Roster,
        runtime: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig,
    ) -> gdl_runtime::gdl::Result<gdl_runtime::Serving> {
        let Hosts {
            nodes,
            frontend,
            entry_487474705f636861745f6630,
            entry_487474705f636861745f6230,
            entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70,
            entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70,
        } = hosts;
        let segment = crate::start(node, roster, runtime, nodes)?;
        Ok(gdl_runtime::Serving::new(
            segment,
            |segment, shutdown| async move {
                let pipeline_48747470 = segment.client(|roots| roots.clone());
                let clients = ::api_frontend::ApiClients {
                    chat: Some(gdl_runtime::gdl::Client::new(
                        gdl_runtime::gdl::Source::new(gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new(
                            (std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f636861745f6630), ()),
                            gdl_runtime::gdl::Join::new(pipeline_48747470.clone()),
                            (std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f636861745f6230), ()),
                        )),
                    )),
                    responses: Some(gdl_runtime::gdl::Client::new(
                        gdl_runtime::gdl::Source::new(gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new(
                            (),
                            gdl_runtime::gdl::OperatorStage::new(
                                std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f726573706f6e7365735f6f70),
                                gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new(
                                    (),
                                    gdl_runtime::gdl::Join::new(pipeline_48747470.clone()),
                                    (),
                                ),
                            ),
                            (),
                        )),
                    )),
                    anthropic: Some(gdl_runtime::gdl::Client::new(
                        gdl_runtime::gdl::Source::new(gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new(
                            (),
                            gdl_runtime::gdl::OperatorStage::new(
                                std::sync::Arc::new(entry_487474705f616e7468726f7069635f6f70),
                                gdl_runtime::gdl::Hop::new(
                                    (),
                                    gdl_runtime::gdl::Join::new(pipeline_48747470.clone()),
                                    (),
                                ),
                            ),
                            (),
                        )),
                    )),
                };
                gdl_runtime::gdl::Service::serve(frontend, clients, async move {
                    shutdown.cancelled().await
                })
                .await
            },
        ))
    }
}

==> front/src/main.rs <==
// @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
// Regenerate with: cargo gdl export --spec ../gdl.toml --out <archive.tar.gz>

//! Runs segment `front` on its own.
//!
//! Usage: `api-front <config.toml> [override.toml ...]`. Files merge in argument
//! order, then `GDL_` environment variables, with `__` between nested keys
//! (`GDL_RUNTIME__ADMISSION_LIMIT=64`). `api-front --healthcheck <config.toml> ...`
//! asks a running instance's health probe instead, as a container health check
//! does. Log events go to stderr, at the level `RUST_LOG` sets (`warn` by default).
//! The settings are:
//!
//! ```toml
//! listen = "127.0.0.1:0"       # this instance's address; under a hub, an unspecified one advertises what HOSTNAME resolves to
//! roster = "/run/roster"       # a directory every instance shares, fresh for each deployment
//! # [hub]                      # or the discovery hub: exactly one of the two
//! # host = "hub"               # its host; public_port, control_port, and heartbeat_ms (5000) are optional
//! rendezvous_ms = 30000        # optional: how long to wait for the other instances
//! [instances]                  # optional, with a roster: instances per segment, 1 by default
//! [min_replicas]               # optional, with a hub: loaded instances per segment to wait for, 1 by default
//! [runtime]                    # optional: gdl_runtime::RuntimeConfig
//! [system]                     # optional: the live and health probes, off unless port is set (DYN_SYSTEM_PORT)
//! [frontend]                   # the source frontend's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_chat_f0]       # optional: entry adapter Http_chat_f0's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_chat_b0]       # optional: entry adapter Http_chat_b0's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_responses_op]  # optional: entry adapter Http_responses_op's Build::Config
//! [adapter.Http_anthropic_op]  # optional: entry adapter Http_anthropic_op's Build::Config
//! ```
//! Graph-affecting values must match the built graph.
//!
//! The source frontend serves once its segments are ready, and drains on
//! SIGINT or SIGTERM.

fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    let filter = tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter::builder()
        .with_default_directive(tracing_subscriber::filter::LevelFilter::WARN.into())
        .from_env_lossy();
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter(filter)
        .with_writer(std::io::stderr)
        .with_ansi(false)
        .init();
    gdl_runtime::segment_main::<api_front::Binary>()
}

# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit
FROM rust:1.93.1-slim-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
ENV CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build
RUN cargo install --git 'https://github.com/ryanolson/gdl' --rev '<rev>' --locked --root /build-tools gdl-hub
FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /build-tools/bin/gdl-hub /usr/local/bin/segment
COPY ["./deployment.json", "/etc/gdl/config"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/segment","/etc/gdl/config"]
